title: Pajānam
text: 2-7 Cakkhum bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Sotaṃ || Ghānam || Jivhaṃ || Kāyam || Manam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || 8-13 Cakkhuñ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayam pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || Sotaṃ || Ghānaṃ || Jivhaṃ || Kāyam || Manam abhijānam parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajaham bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti || || [page 090] 90 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 112. 2
